ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 45:55 high-intensity (white/light grey) to low-intensity (black) pixel distribution across the visible fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central region dominated by a continuous low-intensity (black) mass extending from the peduncle to the mid-lobe. Distal lobes exhibit high-intensity (white) fields. Transition zones show high-frequency speckling/mottling at the interface of black and white regions, particularly on the lower interior edge of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 72 degrees and a deep vertical penetration relative to the lobe peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations detected along the entire superior boundary. Variations range from small 2-3 pixel micro-notches to larger 10-15 pixel jagged peaks, most pronounced on the right lobe distal edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral convex curvature on the superior edge, tapering sharply to points at the lateral extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density, high-contrast irregular clusters (barnacle colonization) localized at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Two distinct dark linear pixel disruptions visible on the left lobe's white field: one primary diagonal mark (approx. 45-degree angle) and one secondary horizontal mark below it.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular tissue loss and calcified texture at the lateral tips, consistent with long-term abrasive wear or parasitic attachment.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique 'salt-and-pepper' pixel distribution isolated within the interior high-intensity field of the right lobe, appearing as discrete black islands.
